prompt: Which hostname follows the Redis Cloud static endpoint pattern of redis-<port>.c<number> followed by the region and cloud domain?
explanation: Static endpoints begin with redis-<port>.c<number> — the database's assigned port is right there in the name. Hostnames of three random words ending in db.redis.io are dynamic endpoints, which can be redirected to a different database, and the other two options are not Redis Cloud endpoint formats at all.
